name: comp-120
blurb: Social login icon buttons with brand colors (Google red, Facebook blue, X black, GitHub black).
description: Four outline icon buttons for social login with brand-specific colors. Icons use hardcoded hex for brand colors with dark mode fallback to primary.
use_when: Offering social authentication with recognizable brand colors.
avoid_when: When you need customizable colors or when brand colors conflict with your theme.
a11y: Each button uses aria-label to describe the provider. Icons are aria-hidden.
